proposed_helper_contract.API: One original derive_control_protection(setup,canonical_base_policy,scratch,out_receipt) plus a trusted derive_and_configure_private wrapper; pure computations/normal output writes and kernel CPU address queries only. No new activation capability.
proposed_helper_contract.trusted_source: setup must originate from the exact frozen bpn_native_pin_empty result and stay immutable. Validate nonzero identity/generation, identity==typed_anchor_cpu.base, exact checked span and opaque mutex identity, and initial trusted single-thread boot state before any backing client exists. No user-supplied VA/PA or host-fixture address input is admitted.
proposed_helper_contract.mutex: Call IOLockGetMachLock on setup opaque_mutex_identity, require nonnull returned pointer, alignment8, and equality to that exact identity under this pinned implementation. Use sizeof(lck_mtx_t)==16 from target type, not sizeof opaque IOLock, a guessed allocator slot size or an arbitrary surrounding page count. Preserve typed span metadata and then cover every intersecting16K page.
proposed_helper_contract.inputs: Trusted immutable domain/RAM/base-reserved policy bounded by BPL_RANGES8; ordinary caller-owned scratch and output disjoint from setup/policy and both exact control spans. No dynamic allocation by helper. Caller owns stable boot lifetime of anchor and mutex; no clients/waiters/free/unload/remap during derivation.
bounded_page_collection: Validate nonzero typed anchor span, mutex span16, checked half-open end without overflow and exact page-size profile; reject byte-span overlap between distinct anchor/mutex objects, but sharing an underlying page is legitimate.

Enumerate align_down(first), through align_down(last_byte) inclusive for each CPU span; use checked addition, never unchecked round-up at UINT64_MAX. Every page increment must progress and fit without wrapping. Deduplicate CPU page addresses; at most8 unique CPU pages total or refuse, no truncation.

Query each exact page base via pmap_find_phys(kernel_pmap,VA). kernel_pmap must be nonnull/stable. Require nonzero ppnum and the22-bit physical-profile bound before widened shift14. Require entire PA page contained in one declared RAM range and no overlap with any base forbidden/reserved range. If policy already classifies that page reserved and its ownership cannot be distinguished, refuse; do not waive a carveout guard.

Do not require physically contiguous anchor pages or guess PA from VA. Distinct control VA pages may alias one PA page; conservatively protect its union once while retaining all CPU coverage. This grants no alias permission to future data pages.

Produce exact typed span metadata and complete CPU page-cover/PA page lists. Sorting/dedup/coalescing may join overlapping or directly adjacent full pages only, preserving exactly their union and never bridging holes.
stable_two_pass: Capture immutable setup/base policy/kernel_pmap/getter identity. Make first bounded VA->ppnum vector pass, then second in identical VA order while anchor/mutex lifetime is held.

Recheck kernel_pmap pointer, current PAGE_SHIFT/page_size and getter identity at boundaries. Require identical ppnum for every VA in both passes. A change, zero mapping, failed bound or different setup/policy rejects without retry or output change.

At most16 pmap_find_phys queries for8 CPU pages, plus bounded getter/check calls. No loop until stable. Double pass detects change between samples only; it does not prove future immutability. Stable wired ownership and serialized boot setup remain required.
proposed_helper_contract.output_atomicity: All-or-nothing caller-visible transaction, not atomic multiword publication to concurrent readers. Scratch may change on failure; out_receipt is written only once after all validation/identity/two-pass/range/union/capacity checks succeeded. Caller serializes output access. No partially complete=1 or provisional PA array escapes.

actual typed underlying mutex CPU base/bytes/size/align facts

complete flag set only at final success; no hardware-ready/ownership/drain Boolean
proposed_helper_contract.policy_merge: Final policy retains all original domain labels, RAM intervals and forbidden reservations, plus the full derived control PA page union. Canonical sorted union may merge overlap/adjacency only; refuse if final reserved count>8 or any field cannot be represented. Never drop an old reservation or bridge a gap to fit. Protection lists each also respect8. Exact canonical policy comparison uses declared fields/active ranges with zero unused tails, not raw padding-sensitive memcmp.
proposed_helper_contract.configure_wrapper: Trusted phase2 wrapper derives fresh receipt internally from its held phase1 setup + base policy, validates exact setup/generation/type profile and receipt final policy, then calls frozen bpn_native_configure with that same setup, that exact final policy and exact derived protection. It accepts no caller-provided detached receipt as authorization. Return receipt to caller only after known configure result according to explicit API. No data descriptors allocated or prepared before known configuration success.
proposed_helper_contract.mixing_and_privilege_boundary: Frozen bpn_native_configure checks setup identity but only nonzero protection.provenance; it does not authenticate a derivation receipt. New platform call path must route configure through the checked wrapper. Direct privileged calls to frozen raw configure remain technically possible and are outside this trusted call-path contract; wrapper is not a security boundary or retroactive frozen-source enforcement.
proposed_helper_contract.failure_behavior: Reject/type mismatch/capacity/mapping-change/unknown outcome leaves output untouched and does not call configure, allocate data, reinitialize/free controls, relax reservations or invoke another derivation automatically. Anchor/mutex stay boot-retained as frozen provider already requires. Pure configuration correction before any manager/native backing activity remains separate from hardware recovery.
